units.source_text: 阿雪的母亲就在这个镇上生下了她的弟弟，产后发高烧，虽然保住了性命，却发疯了。

en.t: Oyuki's mother gave birth to her younger brother in this very town, and after the delivery she developed a high fever; although her life was saved, she went mad.

units.source_text: 白天，父亲和爷爷都出门干活，阿雪留守家中，她趁母亲疯病发作的间隙，悄悄把婴儿抱到母亲的乳房下。

en.t: During the day, her father and grandfather both went out to work, and Oyuki stayed behind at home; in the intervals between her mother's fits of madness, she quietly carried the baby to her mother's breast.

units.source_text: 父亲早出，总要用草绳把母亲的手脚捆绑起来，每回都是阿雪帮她解开的。

en.t: Whenever her father left early in the morning, he would always tie her mother's hands and feet with straw rope, and each time it was Oyuki who untied her.

units.source_text: 母亲发病只四十天，就溘然长逝了。

en.t: Only forty days after her illness began, her mother suddenly passed away.
